public.text: Transparency is required only for disclosure to “appropriate stakeholders,” which leaves substantial discretion and may permit governance decisions affecting the public to remain inaccessible.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a presumption of public disclosure for policies, standards, major decisions, performance reports, and resource-allocation criteria, with limited exceptions for security, confidentiality, procurement sensitivity, and protected personal information.
